about: The cell's render bundle pin. The task's cell checks that the bundle's manifest.json has this sha256 at every mission (mission/bundle.py), and so do tests/test.sh and environment/setup/setup.sh before they start; environment/assets.sha256 pins the archive. Rebuilt 2026-11-16 with a manifest that names packs and file names only: every texture and mesh is byte-identical to the frozen look's archive 2f9a52c7c0ccda3f09fa3755a810c7e4dffb4eb54e7c85f105889bf7495063d7.
